notes.title: Notice Regarding Bannibou Shop Issue
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

We would like to inform you of the following issue.

We have confirmed an issue where the Delilah Shop would appear instead of Bannibou even though the Bannibou Shop splash art appeared upon clearing Abyss: Disciple of Doom.
This issue will be fixed during the MAY 13 maintenance.

If you have experienced this issue, please send us a ticket that includes the following information.


 Character IGN
 Ocurrance date and time
 DFO.TRC file
- Please check, then copy/paste the DFO.trc file located here: "C:\Users""your PC name""\AppData\LocalLow\DNF\DFO.trc
 Screenshot of the issue

Once we have confirmed your issue, we will notify you of what Bannibou Shop items had been available at the time of its occurance and provide additional support should you wish to purchase them.

We apologize for the inconvenience that arose from this issue and thank you for your understanding.


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding Upcoming Character/Explorer Club Name Reset Event *UPDATED*
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

Please be informed of the following details regarding the reset of character/Explorer Club names for accounts with long-term inactivity.


▣ Reset Subjects

 Explore Club: Explorer Club names of accounts with no character logins since 09:00, JAN 1, 2023 UTC.
 Character: Character names of characters that have no logins since 09:00, JAN 1, 2023 UTC.
※ For Explorer Club names, those which have had their character enter Seria's Room will not be subject to the reset.
※ For character names, those who have entered Seria's Room will not be subject to the reset. (However, each individual character must enter to Seria's Room to be excluded from the reset.)

▣ Reset Schedule
- Name securing period: Notices regarding Explorer Club and character login for names subject to being reset will be given via our homepage and within the game after the MAR 18, 2025 maintanence until before the APR 15, 2025 UTC maintenance.
- Reset: Explorer Club and character names subject to the reset will be reset during the APR 15, 2025 UTC maintenance.

 Explorer Club/Character Renaming Ticket will be issued to all accounts that participate in an event that will be available after the APR 15 maintenance. (Regardless of reset status) Names that have been reset can be created/changed starting at 01:00, APR 16, 2025 UTC.
※ A webpage through which you can search names that are scheduled to be reset will be available starting on MAR 18.
※ Accounts and characters whose names have been reset will be able to use a new name upon their first login after the APR 15 maintenance.

Additionally, character names will now be able to have special symbol characters included in them upon creation.

 Currently, Character Rename Tickets already allow the use of these characters when creating character names.
 However, special symbol characters cannot be used in character names when creating new characters currently.
 This discrepancy will be fixed so character names can include special symbol characters upon character creation during the APR 15 maintenance.



Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding Arad Supporters Program
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers!

We would like to inform you of the following changes regarding the Arad Supporters Program.

Due to the start of the new season and the end of the Lv. 110 cap, we must unfortunately announce that the Arad Supporters Program will be coming to a close starting from the MAR 18 maintenance.

As this program was designed to help new Adventurers become up to date with Lv. 110 cap content that had been accumulated over a long period of time, we believe it is now time for this program (and our hard working mentors!) to take a well-deserved break.

We would like to thank all our wonderful Adventurers, both veteran and new, who took part in this program, and hope to re-introduce it in a similar capacity once we get more into the thick of the Sunken Depths season!

We hope everyone enjoys the upcoming and brand-new Sunken Depths content, and we'll be back with news of a new season of the program when available.


Thank you.

- DFO Online Support Team

 

Please Note
※ Access to the Arad Supporters Program Discord server and related activities will continue up until the MAR 18 maintenance.
※ The server will be closed during the MAR 18 maintenance along with the closing of the program.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Upcoming Changes on MAR 4 and MAR 18
notes.content:
Please be informed of the following changes that will occur after the maintenances on Tuesday, MAR 4 and MAR 18 2025 UTC.

Content

▣ Aeterna

 After the maintenance on Tuesday, MAR 4, 2025, the Aeterna channel will be removed, and gameplay will no longer be possible.
 All episode quests available in the Aeterna region will be deleted.
 Items previously obtainable in Aeterna will no longer be available or usable, including:

 Level achievement rewards
 Crafting and material items from Aeterna
 Mission rewards
 Aeterna-exclusive Monster Collection and Equipment Book rewards
 Consumables and equipment sold at Antana Port
 Exploration Level EXP capsules

 During the MAR 4 maintenance, Aeterna-exclusive materials and consumables will be removed.
 Achievements that reward creatures, emoticons, and Silver Amplification Grimoire will remain


▣ Exceed

 Exceed content will be discontinued, and new content will be introduced in an upcoming Sunken Depths update.
 From Saturday, MAR 1, 2025, 09:00 UTC, Exceed will no longer be playable.
 The Exceed channel will remain accessible for collecting FEB play rewards.
 The Exceed channel will be removed at a later date. Please collect your FEB play rewards before the channel is deleted.


▣ Master Kaleido Box

 For Sunken Depths equipment, its rarity will change while maintaining its equipment grade when converted through the Armory or using the Promotion system.
 As a result, the four existing Master Kaleido Box types will be merged into one.
 On Tuesday, MAR 18, 2025, the Master Kaleido Box sold at NPC Seria’s shop will be updated.
 Sales of the current four Master Kaleido Boxes (Rare, Unique, Legendary, and Epic) will be discontinued.
 A new Master Kaleido Box will be added as a purchasable item for 20 Kaleido Boxes.
 Existing Master Kaleido Boxes will remain usable on equipment up to Lv. 110 and can be refunded through NPC Seria.
 A refund tab will be added to NPC Seria’s shop, where refund pots for the four Kaleido Box types will be available.


▣ Transcendent Stone

 Due to the Sunken Depths equipment system changes, the existing Transcendent Stone and One-Shot Transcendent Stone for equipment will be adjusted as follows:

 Both stones will be limited to use on equipment up to Lv. 110.
 On Tuesday, MAR 4, 2025, equipment Transcendent Stone sales will be discontinued in the CERA Shop.
 Details on the new Sunken Depths equipment Transcendent system will be announced in a future update notice.



▣ Codename: Gaebolg

 The Codename: Gaebolg content will be removed with the Sunken Depths update.
 On Tuesday, MAR 18, 2025, the Codename: Gaebolg channel will be deleted, and gameplay will no longer be possible.
 Resources related to Insignia upgrade and reinforcement will be transferred to the new Sunken Depths dungeons.
 Monster Fragments used in the Codename: Gaebolg Monster Collection will no longer be obtainable.
 Players who wish to claim Codename: Gaebolg Monster Collection rewards should do so before MAR 18.


▣ Noblesse Code

 The Noblesse Code content will be removed with the Sunken Depths update.
 On Tuesday, MAR 18, 2025, the Noblesse Code channel will be deleted, and gameplay will no longer be possible.
 Noblesse Code entry tickets will become unusable.
 Players who wish to use their Noblesse Code entry tickets must do so before MAR 18.


▣ Arad Adventure

 The Arad Adventure content within the Explorer Club will be removed with the Sunken Depths update.
 All Adventure Rubies and Mercenary Recruitment Tickets purchased from the CERA Shop and Mileage Shop will be extracted and compensated with Remy’s Shining Touch.
 Each purchased Adventure Ruby or Mercenary Recruitment Ticket will be exchanged for 1 Remy’s Shining Touch.
 Adventure Rubies obtained through gameplay will not be compensated.
 All purchased Adventure Rubies and Mercenary Recruitment Tickets will be exchanged regardless of whether they were used.
 The exact compensation schedule will be announced in a future notice.


▣ White Ocean Coin Shop / Records of Shining Adventure Shop

 The White Ocean Coin Shop will be available until MAR 18, 2025, and the Records of Shining Adventure Shop will be available until APR 1, 2025.
 On Tuesday, FEB 11, 2025, a deletion date will be added for White Ocean Coins and Records of Shining Adventures.

 White Ocean Coins will be deleted on MAR 18, 2025, at 09:00 UTC.
 Records of Shining Adventures will be deleted on APR 1, 2025, at 09:00 UTC.

 On MAR 18, 2025, NPC Elieve’s White Ocean Coin Shop will be removed.
 On APR 1, 2025, NPC Elieve’s Records of Shining Adventure Shop will be removed.
 On MAR 18, 2025, NPC Elieve will be removed from Seria’s room.

 After the MAR 18 maintenance, the Records of Shining Adventure Shop will still be accessible via NPC Elieve in Clearmist Plaza.

※ White Ocean Coins can be obtained until MAR 18, 2025, before they are deleted. Please use them before removal.


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding Disconnection Issue on JAN 9 *UPDATED*
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

Ever since the disconnection issues on JAN 9, we understand that there have been issues with purchasing or selling items through the Auction Hall.
We greatly appreciate your patience and understanding regarding this belated notice as we  strove to thoroughly investigate the issue before taking appropriate measures .

We have identified and fixed the issues related to the abnormalities of the Auction Hall,and it is now functioning as intended.

We will address all items that were sold in the Auction Hall or registered but not sold, ensuring that players receive proper sales proceeds and expired items accordingly.

We will take action to process these items as quickly as possible and notify you once everything is complete.

However, identifying cases where an item was purchased from the Auction Hall but not received is a more complex issue.
As such, if you have experienced this issue, we kindly ask that you notify us by sending us a ticket.
Upon confirmation, we will ensure that the purchased item is properly delivered. 


*UPDATED*
The issue (excluding cases where an item was purchased from the Auction Hall but was not received) has been fixed.
Please check your mailbox to receive items related to the issue.
If you cannot see your items in your mailbox, please proceed with the following steps.
[olist]
 Change channel
 Exit to the character selection screen, then enter the game again
 Check your mailbox for new mail
[/olist]

Thank you for your understanding.


- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding Compensation for God of Mist Raid Closure
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

We would like to inform you of the following regarding the issue of Asrahan: Mu, God of Mist Raid not being available on OCT 13.

We are aware that due to this technical issue, some Adventurers decided to clear Asrahan: Curtains of Mu as it was not made clear if Asrahan: Mu, God of Mist Raid would be available again before the weekly reset. This resulted in these Adventurers missing out on God of Mist Raid rewards.
To offer compensation for this issue and any inconveniences caused, we will be accepting tickets and providing compensation for Adventurer characters that meet all the following criteria.

[olist]
 Had at least 58,087 or higher Fame at 09:00, OCT 13 UTC.
 Cleared Asrahan: Curtains of Mu Hard Mode on OCT 13 between 09:00 UTC and when Asrahan: Mu, God of Mist was re-opened.
 Cleared Asrahan: Mu, God of Mist Raid between OCT 17, 09:00 until when the God of Mist Raid channel closes for this week.
[/olist]

If you meet all the criteria above, please send us a ticket until 09:00, OCT 24 UTC for us to confirm your request and send you our compensation item during the NOV 5 maintenance.
When sending in a ticket, please make sure to have the following information included in your request.
[olist]
 List of character names that meet the criteria above.
 Date/time of God of Mist Raid clear
[/olist]

Upon confirming your ticket, we will send a box containing the following rewards that would have been missed out on due to clearing Curtains of Mu (Hard Mode) instead of God of Mist Raid to each character's mailbox accordingly.

 Dim Floating Stone x10
 Meteoria x32
 Tales of Bravery – Asrahan x1
 Five Element Flow x10
 Boundary Fragment  x18
 Stable Boundary Fragment x3

The box will also have a set chance to yield 1 Engraved Memory Shard at the same rate they can be obtained as Raid clear rewards.

Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience that arose from this issue and hope this compensation will allow you to continue enjoying the latest Raid content.


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Update Regarding Recovery Support Policy
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

Please be informed of the following updates/changes regarding our Recovery Support Policy which will be effective as of the FEB 20, 2024 update.


1. Users will now be eligible for up to 5 recoveries per year per account. 
- Previously: One recovery per account
(Yearly cycle will be based on the date of an account's first recovery request)

2. Recovery will only be available for requests made within the following time period.
- Items: Within 3 days of the time of incident.
- Character Deletion: Within 25 days of the time of character deletion.

3. Support will now be available for the following cases.

 Custom Option transfer
 Option growth
 Enchants - Enchants will now be restored to recovered items where possible


Please note that although we will strive to provide as much assistance in as various cases as possible, recovery may still be limited in some cases.

The following limitations may be applied when applying for recovery.

 Some aspects of items may not be recovered if they include probability-based features 
 (e.g. Reinforcement, amplification, etc.)
Recovery requests made for mistakes that occurred in spite of system safety measures may be denied. (e.g. Typing in confirmation text.)
Materials/resulting items from the incident must be in possession in order for recovery to be processed (e.g. Character must possess the corresponding amount of Epic Souls to be deleted in order for equipment to be recovered after a disassemblement mistake.)
Consumable/materials used during the process of a mistake may not be returned upon item recovery.
Restrictions to items issued may be added (e.g. Tradable items may be recovered as account-bound/untradable


As we offer recovery support on a case-by-case basis, please send us a ticket and our support team will let you know if we can assist you in any way possible if you're unsure as to whether your case is eligible for recovery.

You can check out additional details regarding recovery requests through our FAQs.

We hope these changes will better help our Adventurers on their adventures in spite of any honest mistakes that might be made on the way!


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding In-Game/Webpage Login Synchronization
notes.content:
Greeting Adventurers,

We have synchronized logins from within our game to our CERA purchase & DFO Web Store webpages. Please read the following for details regarding how they have been synchronized.


When moving to the CERA payment page or DFO Web Store page from within the game, you will automatically login to the corresponding webpage with the account that is currently logged into the game.
ㄴ The login session will be maintained for 30 minutes when moving to the CERA payment page or DFO Web Store page within the game.

If the account logged into the webpage is different from the account logged into the game, the webpage will be logged out forcibly and then logged in automatically with the account logged into the game to access the webpage.
ㄴ In this case, the login session for the accessed webpage is also maintained for 30 minutes.

If the account logged into the webpage is the same as the account logged into the game, the webpage login status will remain unchanged.
ㄴ If automatic login is enabled for the webpage, the login session will not be disconnected.
ㄴ If automatic login is not enabled for the webpage, the login session will be maintained for 3 hours.

For account security reasons, please make sure to log out when accessing the CERA payment page or DFO Web Store page in a public space.


We hope this change will allow our Adventurers to make purchases more conveniently by reducing unnecessary logins.
If you encounter any problems or inconveniences, please submit a Support Ticket for us to look into!


Thank you.

- DFO Online Support Team

Greetings DFO Adventurers,

We would like to inform you of the following issues regarding the Guardians of the Forest Creature .


1. The correct list of Creature enhanced skills was not included in the link for the Guardians of the Forest Package page. The correct list has now been added.

2.  The Guardians of the Forest Creature's active skill effect is currently applied as increased Physical/Magical/Independent Atk., not Increased Atk. This bug will be fixed during the MAR 22 maintenance.

We sincerely apologize for any inconveniences caused by this issue and thank you for your understanding.


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding Arad Pass Season 2 *UPDATED*
notes.content:
Greetings DFO Adventurers,

We would like to inform you of the following issue.

[strike]We have confirmed a shutdown error with the current Arad Pass Season 2.
This issue is currently under investigation, and we will be announcing news regarding its fix and compensation through tomorrow's maintenance.[/strike]

The issue has been resolved.

The following will be issued as compensation for the error.

1. The Arad Pass Season 2 Shutdown Error Compensation Box II, which contains 5 Arad Pass EXP +1000 Tickets, will be issued upon login until 09:00, DEC 28 UTC for all Adventurers.
2. Additionally, Adventurers that purchased the Royal Pass will receive the Arad Pass Season 2 Shutdown Error Compensation Box I in their previous Royal Pass Character's mailbox, which contains a Royal Pass Exclusive Rewards Retrieval Ticket. This item will allow temporary Royal Pass Exclusive Rewards to be received again.

We sincerely apologize for any inconveniences caused by this issue and thank you for your understanding.


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Grave Tower
notes.content:
Grave Tower
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/f4b92ef6aa55512233dfb82e23c51d4a0867125a.jpg

In the corner of the Valley of the Fallen Souls, there lived a grave robber named Grave.

Ugly and gloomy, he cursed the rest of the world that had shunned him and found comfort in digging the ground, seeking graves to rob.

One day, he found some sorcerer's coffin and a spellbook inside.

This book contained a wicked spell that could create fearsome soldiers out of memories of anger and hatred.

Grave's face contorted into a loathsome grin as he closed the book. He had plenty of angry memories that he could use.

Greetings DFO Adventurers,

notes.title: Notice Regarding Event Abuse Weapon Deletion
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

As mentioned in our previous notice, although the standard procedure for abusing event features would be to enforce account bans, we acknowledge that some of the fault lay in the design and execution of the DFO Hero Academy event, and thus with ourselves. Accordingly, we would like to inform you of the following measures that will be implemented.

1. The following items/materials will be reissued for Adventurers whose weapons were deleted.

- Immaterial Essence: If your weapon imbued with Immaterial Essence was deleted, please send a ticket before the JUL 13 maintenance with details regarding your weapon. Submit a ticket: https://neople.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new
PLEASE REFRAIN FROM SENDING ADDITIONAL TICKETS IF YOU HAVE ALREADY SENT ONE REGARDING THE SAME MATTER PRIOR TO THIS NOTICE. TICKETS WILL BE REVIEWED IN THE ORDER THAT THEY ARE SUBMITTED. 
 
- Epic Souls: 70% of all Epic Souls used to Transcend weapons that were deleted will be reissued on the JUL 13 maintenance.

2. As an apology for the frustration and emergency maintenance caused by the ambiguity of the DFO Hero Academy event design, as well as reimbursement for deleted Magic Enchants, we will be distributing high-grade Weapon Magic Beads to all users as an extra event reward in the near future. Please stay tuned for more information regarding this compensation.

3. Please note that the following items/materials will NOT be reissued

- Additional Reinforcement levels
- Kaleido Boxes
- Gold
- Deleted characters

4. Adventurers who have been found to have exploited the event will be blacklisted. Blacklisted users will face more severe sanctions if found to have abused/exploited the game in any way again in the future.


Thank you.

-Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Notice Regarding DFO Hero Academy Event Abuse (2) *UPDATED*
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers,

We would like to inform you of the following measures regarding abuse of the "Altimate Power Leveling 3.0 - DFO Hero Academy" event.

1. Although the standard procedure for abusing event features would be to enforce account bans, the illicit items obtained through the event have been confiscated and event rewards reissued.

2. Accounts that have utilized multiple characters to Transcend multiple +12 Reinforced, +8 Refined Weapons will be issued the original event reward Weapon Box once per account. Such users must send us a ticket at https://neople.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new with the IGN of the character they wish to receive the reward with. Details regarding when the reward will be reissued to these accounts will be posted in the near future.

3. We will continue monitoring the situation, and will take reasonable action to ensure fairness in cases where items were issued/received unfairly.

4. Players who have selected/created Event Characters prior to the JUN 30 emergency maintenance and wish to reselect their Event Character can send us a ticket at https://neople.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new to have their current Event Character deleted during the JUL 13 maintenance, thus allowing the reselection of another Event Character. However, reward items that have been obtained must be intact and in the character's possession. Accounts with event rewards that have been altered (Inherited, Transcended) will not be eligible to have their Event Character deleted.


Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: Sirocco Guide & Squad Mode
notes.content:
Sirocco Guide Dungeon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/9f1171e46e4afcfb168b7f95fd910122aa045f1f.png
	The Sirocco Raid Guide mode will be added.	You can play this content in a 1-person Raid Group on Solo mode.	You can play once a day, 2 days a week, between Friday ~ Sunday.	This Guide mode shares its Entry count with the Normal and Squad Sirocco Raid modes.	Up to 3 characters can be bound to this dungeon every week, and only those bound characters can enter it.	These bound characters are shared between the Squad and Guide modes.	Starting the Guide dungeon binds your current character to it. (Reset on Tuesdays)	The dungeon's time limit will be deleted.	The original dungeon's difficulty level and composition will be changed to match Solo play.	1 Small Purging Relic is required to use the Sirocco Raid Guide mode.	You can get it through the Small Purging Relic Box sold at the Raid Shop.
 
How to Enter
	In the Sirocco the Intangible Raid channel, select NPC Shinjang's Create Raid Group menu, and then Guide (Solo) to create a Raid Group.	The Entry material, Small Purging Relic, can be obtained through the Small Purging Relic Box sold at the Raid Shop.	Move to the Lobby on the right side and select NPC Zanbato Aganzo's Start Raid menu to start the Raid.
 
Basic Rules
	Entering this dungeon doesnt cost Fatigue.	Life Tokens are limited to 4 per subdungeon.	At least 5,938 Exorcism is required.	The same Consumable use limit as the Normal Raid is applied.	Phantasmal Healing Potions sold by NPC Aganzo can be used.​
 
Differences from Normal Sirocco Raid
	Some Boss monsters display Guide images containing information about certain attack patterns.
	- The dungeon is paused while these Guide images are displayed.
	- You can disable the Guide images by selecting the Disable Guide option.
	- This Disable Guide option is located at the bottom of the Status Board and the Guide window.	Every time you move on to a new floor, the Status Board will be opened automatically, displaying helpful information.
	- You can check the gimmicks in each subdungeon through the Status Board Help messages.
	- You can disable the Guide images by selecting the Disable Guide option.
	- This Disable Guide option is located at the bottom of the Status Board.
	- You can check the Status Board Help messages by clicking the question mark at the bottom left side of the Status Board.	The Guide dungeon is activated in 2 different phases, depending on the number of time you entered it in a week, and it generates different subdungeons on certain floors.
	- Gateway of Trials I/II	Certain floors only generate one subdungeon. When you clear this dungeon, you will be moved to the next floor.
	- Gateway of Laws and Hall of Immateriality Phase 1	Some of the locked dungeons will become immediately accessible.
	- Gateway of Intelligence - Night of Terrors, Border of Phantasm, and Day of Return
	- Gateway of Trials II - Castle of the Phantasm and Phantasm of the Castle
	- Hall of Immateriality Phase 3 - Hall of Subconsciousness: Denial/Suppression	Some of the subdungeons that are regenerated when cleared will not be regenerated.
	- Hall of Immateriality Phase 2 - Altered Hall of Subconsciousness
	- Hall of Immateriality Phase 3 - Hall of Subconsciousness: Suppression/Oblivion	Certain features of the Hall of Immateriality will be modified.
	- When you enter Hall of Consciousness after clearing the Altered Hall of Subconsciousness, Sirocco the Intangible will become Groggy after a while.
	- When you clear the Hall of Subconsciousness: Suppression, you can enter the Hall of Subconsciousness: Oblivion.
	- When you clear the Hall of Subconsciousness: Oblivion, you can enter the True Hall of Consciousness.
	- When you enter the  True Hall of Consciousness and encounter Sirocco, the Hall of Inner Self will be opened after a while.
 
System
	The Radiant Mirro and Radiant Image buff will be applied.
 
Rewards
	The following rewards are given for clearing the Sirocco Raid Guide mode.	Compared to the Normal Sirocco Raid, this dungeon creates a low chance of the Gold Card, but everything else—equipment, cards, etc.—has the same drop rate.	The Sirocco Raid Guide mode, when cleared, doesn't add items to the Loot Shop > Raid Special List
 
 
Sirocco Squad Mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/d35f35ab24141a98ea6005f3c157b8edd58ef009.png
	The Sirocco Raid Squad mode will be added.	This Squad mode is Solo content, and you can enter the dungeon with up to 3 Elite Members that you have set up.	You can set up Elite Members in the Explorer Club (J) > Elite Members tab.	Elite Members, while in use for the Sirocco Squad mode, can't be added to another until 09:00 UTC the next day.	They can, however, be used for the content and have their Elite Member settings changed without restriction.	You can play once a day, 2 days a week, between Friday ~ Sunday.	This Squad mode shares its Entry count with the Normal and Guide Sirocco Raid modes.	Up to 3 characters can be bound to this dungeon every week, and only those bound characters can enter it.	These bound characters are shared between the Squad and Guide modes.	Starting the Squad dungeon binds your current character to it. (Reset on Tuesdays)	The dungeon's time limit will be deleted.	The Squad dungeon features the same process and patterns as the Guide dungeon.	1 Small Purging Relic is required to use the Sirocco Raid Squad mode.	You can get it through the Small Purging Relic Box sold at the Raid Shop.
 
How to Enter
	In the Sirocco Raid Group (Solo) channel, select NPC Shinjangs Create Raid Group menu, and then Squad (Solo) to create a Raid Group.	The Entry material, Small Purging Relic, can be obtained through the Small Purging Relic Box sold at the Raid Shop.	Move to the Lobby on the right side and select NPC Zanbato Aganzo's Start Raid menu to start the Raid.
 
Basic Rules
	Entering this dungeon doesn't cost Fatigue.	Life Tokens are limited to 4 per subdungeon.	At least 5,938 Exorcism is required.	The same Consumable use limit as the Normal Raid is applied.	Phantasmal Healing Potions sold by NPC Aganzo can be used.​
 
System
	The Radiant Mirro and Radiant Image buff will be applied.
 
Rewards
	The following rewards are given for clearing the Sirocco Raid Squad mode.	Compared to the Normal Sirocco Raid, this dungeon creates a low chance of the Gold Card, but everything else—equipment, cards, etc.—has the same drop rate.	The Sirocco Raid Squad mode, when cleared, doesn't add items to the Loot Shop > Raid Special List.
 
Limited Period Snowman Avatar Sales

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/4a60d1002c68e4f107f9b0c98a624bc079aa65e3.png
Get a cute snowman avatar set in White, Gold, Red, Black, Pink, or Blue! Snowman Avatars only appear this special time of this year! Happy Winter Holidays, Adventurers!

notes.title: Season 6 Act 6. Sirocco the Intangible
notes.content:
NEW RAID: SIROCCO RAID
STAND AND FIGHT AGAINST SIROCCO BEFORE THE ROOTS OF FEAR DIG TOO DEEP!
Check out the Promotional Page Here
[previewyoutube=YZ0wxGvfs6E;full][/previewyoutube]

STORY
Sirocco the Intangible (Sirocco's Illusion)
"The One Who Possesses Hundreds of Faces, Yet is Invisible."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/079498a03350eb157a379bf04bc27cf18eb21a80.png

You want to live.

Your unquenchable thirst has made your tongue and eyes as dry as paper.
You angrily stamp your feet, but they only move limply, like withered branches.
Begrudgingly, you think about Pandemonium and the whistling noise that your back used to make as it heaved to inhale the meager energy that the world had to offer.That world was inhabited by pathetic creatures that became scared of the sound of their own breath after night fell.
Faces from that part of your past flash across your mind.
They remind you of the title, Apostle.
Back then, that word felt like a wet leaf stuck to the bottom of your foot. And then, her face.
You can't suppress your anger. You scream.
The coppery taste of blood fills your mouth.
Its scent attracts worms. Slowly, your breathing comes back to normal.

You want to live.

You're tired of these stupid gnats that keep coming at you, no matter how hard you swat at them.
You think, I'm going to wipe them out today, once and for all.
You listen. There are several pairs of feet wandering about inside the cave.
You sit down, coiling like a snake. Actually, you scatter. Like smoke, and sweeping the cave ceiling.
Not even a tendril of light can slip into this merciless place. You claw at the stone wall.
Your nails are peeled back, pushing into your skin.

You know you're going to die today.

But still, you want to live.

You've been wandering, searching for the perfect vessel for your spirit for a long time.
You continue to wander, thinking, One day, I'll reclaim everything I lost.
And I'll pay back everything she gave me.
Because you're intangible, you can be tangible again. You'll exist across time and space.
Whenever you feel sorry for yourself, you think of her face.
The Apostles can't kill each other. That sounds like a dream.
You've been picturing her face streaked with tears as she begs you for her life.
It was the only thing that kept you going.
And finally, you've found the seven.

Resurrection!

At last, it was within your grasp. For it, you can happily destroy every obstacle in your path.
You'll rise as tall as a raging storm, unleashing your flowing power, letting it explode skyward.
You'll wake up! To let those cowards behold your majestic form.
You'll sweep! You'll climb the spine of this world all the way up to the oasis like you've always dreamed.
And you'll drink every drop of water it has to offer!
And then, you will take root through the sky beneath the ocean!

Once, you just wanted to live. But now, you want more.
Worms that have smelled your flower start climbing the stem, tickling you and making you smile
in spite of yourself.

Listen to the Sirocco's Story, The Windborne Flower, here
Find out more about the Character's of Sirocco Raid, here


CONTENT
Summary

 Sirocco the Intangible Raid will be added.
 Sirocco the Intangible Raid is Raid content that can be played by up to 16 players at the same time.
 The Adventurer enters the Sky Tower as it crumbles under the weight of Sirocco the Intangible as she climbs it, and follows her to the top.
 If you subjugate the final enemy, Sirocco the Intangible, you'll get equipment imbued with Sirocco's Energy, among other things. For more information, please refer to the Rewards section.

 The Sirocco Raid is accessible through the Alliance Camp in West Coast.
 The Sirocco Raid Scenario quests will be added.
 You can perform them at Level 100 after the Path to the High Place quest.
 Complete the Back to Where We Belong quest to enter the Sirocco Raid channel.


How to Enter the Raid

 Each character can clear this mode once a day or twice a week on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays.
- Daily Entry count will be reset daily at 09:00 UTC
- Weekly Entry count will be reset on Tuesdays at 09:00 UTC
 It's only accessible from the newly added Sirocco Raid channel.


Entry Materials

 You can buy and use the Purging Relic item to enter this content.
 Purging Relics are available for purchase through NPC Shinjang in the Raid channel or at the Raid Shop.
 Starting the Sirocco Raid requires these Entry materials.


Entry Limit

 Characters at Level 100 or above can enter.
 Complete the Back to Where We Belong quest to enter the Sirocco Raid channel.

 
Raid Basic Rules
Participants

 Up to 16 characters can play it together.

 
Time Limit

 There is a 80-minute time limit.
 Phase 1: 40 min.
 Phase 2: 40 min.
 Wait Time Between Phase: 5 min.
 A separate time limit is applied to each battle.

REWARDS
Raid Clear Rewards

ARENA SEASON 5
Fair Arena
The Fair Arena System will be added to the Rank and Practice Arenas.

Fair Arena Rules
Characters
- Each Advanced class is given unique amounts of stats. Characters of the same Advanced class will have the same amount of stats.
 
Equipment
- Equipment and Enchantment options will not be applied.
- Weapon characteristics for each type will be retained. Weapons of the same type will have the same attack range.
 
Cash Items
- The options of Cash items (titles, Avatars, and Creatures) will not be applied.
- Cube Contracts will be applied. (Gold and Clear Cubes can't be selected.)
 
Arena Grade Update
Tier System
The existing RP System will be replaced by a tier system.
Your tier will be applied to your account, and represent your fighting skill level.
 
Training Grades
The existing Arena EXP grades will be replaced by Training grades.
Training grades are applied to characters, depending on their accumulated Training EXP.

Captain Match Mode
Captain Match Mode will be added to the Rank Arena.
You can use the Captain Mode Matching System after verifying your skill in Placement Matches.
You can use the Matching System individually or in a party to find suitable opponents.
Parties of up to 3 players only. If the Tier gap among party members is too great, the party can't use the Matching System.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/20023cf311f83844cac940da29ce644087203ad5.png
 
Arena Missions & Special Rewards
- Arena Missions
The existing Accomplishment Mission System will be replaced by the Arena Mission System.
You can check the available Arena missions on the bulletin board next to Chobung.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/9bdb683160420af164ca242a5deca44855d413de.png
The Arena missions are classified into the Daily, Weekly, and Season types.
 
- Daily/Weekly Missions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/7ba640ccdf59278e9f37e90131e31397bce041e5.png

- Season Missions
* Daily Missions: Resets daily at 9:00 a.m. Gives Victory Tokens when completed.
* Weekly Missions: Resets every Tuesday. Gives Victory Tokens when completed.
* Season Missions: Resets at the end of each season. Give Victory Tokens and Essence Pro Bruiser Weapon Boxes when completed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/f69a67d3971862ec9423dc13e43e25373b762c4d.png

Special Rewards
Win 1:1 and Captain matches, and you'll get a certain number of Victory Tokens each time.
You can only receive a limited amount of Special rewards a day, and your record is reset daily at 9:00 a.m.
For more information on rewards, please check here.

Arena Reward Changes
NPCs Chobung and Sizki will now sell different Reward products.
You can buy them with Victory Tokens.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/9fec37c2efb3ed36d7e60b3dd8d148bd941ea983.png



Pandemonium War Challenge Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/a15c5000e8b9e377205078b606df36f77a643c31.png

Entry

 You can create a Pandemonium War Challenge party in the Pandemonium War channel through NPC Ikki the Vikki's Create Pandemonium War Party menu.
 You must be Level 100 or above to enter.
 This dungeon shares its Entry count with the Pandemonium War Normal, Hard, and Guide dungeons (once a day and twice a week per character).
 30 Fatigue is required to enter.
 Your Entry count will be reset every Tuesday at 9:00 a.m.
 Pandemonium War Challenge mode is for solo play only.

 
Content Info

 In Pandemonium War Challenge mode, monster stats are increased, certain fighting patterns are reinforced, and new fighting patterns are added.
 4 Life Tokens can be used in each dungeon.
 The following Consumables can't be used.
 - Puppet items
 - Sacred Blessings, Heavenly HP Potions, Divine Revival Formulas, Heavenly Potions, and Immortality Formulas
 5,935 Exorcism is required to enter.
 The Sword and Shield dungeon increases your Atk. by 30% when cleared (up to a total of 60%, depending on the dungeons you clear).
 The Flag of the Alliance buff can't be applied to Challenge mode.


Rewards
Please check the table here.



CONVENIENCE IMPROVEMENT
Disassembler/Extractor UI Improvement
The Disassembler and Extractor UI will be improved for convenience of use.
- The Profession Disassembler/Extractor and the regional Portable Equipment Disassembler will now display slots at the bottom of their window, so you can drag and drop items onto them.
- The existing Disassembler/Extractor's Select Multi and Select All menus will be retained.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/98c7ca255709e72057370752837eb1017104d2ee.png

Additional Graphic Options
You can adjust the game screen's brightness, contrast, and gamma value.
Now, color filters are supported to help you distinguish colors.
- Green-weak, Red-weak, and Blue-yellow-weak
You can turn your color and color filter settings on and off by typing the dungeon command, //screenfilter, into the Chat window.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/f3dd0f81d661579f29b86a6060d60355e0503889.png
 

Episode Quest Skip Menu Added
The Episode quests can now be skipped through the Clear Quest menu if certain conditions are met.
- They can be skipped once they are cleared once per account.
- This menu doesn't generate rewards, just like the Clear Current Quest menu for the Act Quests.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/4badcbb0b3dc27305061b9a938d75c2ae1fcf84d.png

Additional Improvements
In the Dungeon Selection window, slots will now move in order if you navigate them with the arrow keys.    
Texture Upscaling mode: If the game resolution is changed to 800x600, it will now be disabled instead of automatically turned off.    
- Texture Upscaling mode can now only be terminated if you manually turn it off in Options.
The Event Icon word bubbles, if minimized, will stay minimized until you reconnect to the client program.    
Text-entering speed in the Auction Hall's Search function will be improved.

BUG FIXES
For details on fixes bugs, please check here.

notes.title: Season 6 Act 1.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=9kUmo9cxuMc;full][/previewyoutube]

Season 6 Act 1. ASCENSION
Level
Max Level Expansion
- The Maximum Character Level will be increased from 95 to 100.
 
Village
Ghent the New Capital
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/1628c0ca6139030501114cac0ebf4aceb464e797.png
Ghent the City of God has risen from the ashes of horrific wars. The Emperor Government, once a name used to refer to as the massive Empyrean continent before it was split, is now the four islands that make up this new Empyrean under the reign of the first emperor since Bakal.

A. Entry 
Complete the Empress Erje Act quest, and Ghent the City of God will be updated to Ghent the New Capital.

B. New NPCs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/220039d65b4b719ca2eb6f10c7198fd17ce86270.png
Hugh Fitzlary (Male, aged 32)
One of the Seven Shards who studies to combine magical energy with Empyrean's scientific technology. An expert on explosives.

He grew up in Northpiece, thanks to his mother who was a great trader, but he isn't highborn. The Nobility vehemently opposed when he was first considered as a Shard, not only because of his commoner status, but also because of their suspicion in this thing called magic that he advocated.

However, Beldron, the archpriest at that time, made him a Shard despite its opposition and secretly funded his magic research.
 
After the path down to the Sky Tower was opened, Hugh applied for Empyrean's delegation to Underworld, and disappeared on the first day he arrived in Arad. Several incidents suspected to be of his doing have been reported since then, but no one knows exactly where he is.

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/67a50839a764c098eb32276bbf09650458e5fa65.png
Edwin Jurgen (Male, aged 24)
The youngest child of Nevillo Jurgen, who has three sons and a daughter.

Born as a frail child, he was spoiled when he was young, but he gradually recovered his health and showed exceptional intelligence, earning special attention from his father.

When he realized that his father's favoritism toward him caused his sister Marianne to seethe with jealousy, Edwin used his physical frailty as an excuse to avoid getting embroiled in the succession war among his siblings.

He also secluded himself from the world outside his mansion, but he couldn't stop the gossip and rumors about him.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/847adca0ce0687c0d6a1f3f7f17ecff44d0111c3.png
Lindsey Rossum (Female, aged 28)
The only daughter of the Rossums, a family of scholars known for their intelligence and uprightness.

Her family values scholarship over wealth, and most of them would rather study in seclusion than help the rest of the world with their knowledge. Thus, Lindsey had difficulty spreading her wings,
but that didn't stop her from dreaming of joining the Seven Shards and contributing to the development of Empyrean one day. When she finally achieved her dream, despite the fact that she wasn't wealthy or even a successor of one of the Seven Meisters, the Rossums became very proud.

She specializes in energy research, and is currently studying to develop and popularize new alternative energy sources, so as to reduce Empyrean's dependency on the electricity from Etten.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/33196b7a14b4d960d09783c21926134b38e94230.png 
Gina Theodor (Female, aged 35)
The head of the Optimus Factory, she is known for her weapons that are as beautiful as they are deadly.

She became so famous for her engineering skills, straightforward personality, and natural leadership that she once was considered as a new Shard, but the Nobility Council dismissed her. It didn't think someone of dubious origin like her should join the Seven Shards, who served the Princess by her side.

Ironically, Gina's biggest client was the Nobility. And so, Gina took a dislike to the Nobility, even though she wasn't interested in becoming a Shard.

Gina provided her Factory's weapons to the Army since Anton showed up in Etten, which has attracted a big fan base for her throughout Empyrean.

C. Available Dungeons
Ghent Palace
 
Chest Town
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/7cbf349ada2756f4fc6879ed397826518186df83.jpg
The place where Ozma was sealed along with Michael during the Black Crusade. Since the sealing of the Dark Side, mineral veins were discovered in that area. The De Los Empire then named it Los Chest, meaning the storage of the Empire. Chest Town is the mining village for that area, established by the Empire with an active relocation policy.

 A. Entry
Complete The Priest Order's Summons Act quest to enter this map through Elvenguard.

B. New NPCs

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/47ddb57320432054f47e908c2fc57e2c10b15652.png 
Van Frantz (Male, aged 22)
The first prince of the Del Los Empire, who's also the first in line to the throne. His full name is Ashen Van Frantz Heinrich De Los.

Born to Emperor Leon and Empress Consort Josephine, he may not look like his father as much as he resembles his mother, but he's just as aggressive and bold as his father. Self-centered, high-handed, and especially good at commanding those beneath him.

He's not afraid of showing his ambition for the throne, and puts his rivals in check every chance he gets. Because of this, he's not on good terms with his siblings except for the third princess, Isabella, or even with his father, Emperor Leon.

After he came of age, he volunteered to govern the Desert of Ashen on the north side of the Empire that belongs to his mother's family. He has been spending most of his time coming and going between the capital city and his domain.

C. Available Dungeons 

 Land of Memories
 Bottomless Tunnel
 Basement of Pain
 Black Shrine

 

West Coast Alliance Camp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/80cd31759c6eaef50a67092445ccfa9ce5d668e7.jpg
West Coast is a trading city of the Principality of Bel Myre. It was thrown into confusion when a massive storm broke out and the land under the Sky Tower rose overnight.

Empress Skardi of Bel Myre, having realized the seriousness of the situation that affected the whole continent, proposed an alliance to the other countries in Arad. The De Los Empire, Suju, and the Fennes Kingdom accepted her proposition, and even the Bantus and the Adventurer's Guild joined the Alliance.
Empress Skardi closed West Coast and built a camp for the Alliance there, announcing it as the base for the Alliance.

A. Entry 
Complete the Right and Wrong Act quest, and West Coast will be updated to the West Coast Alliance Camp. The Central Tent will appear in this camp, which is accessible through West Coast and West Coast Harbor.
 
B. New NPCs 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/8df1a6b08509e25f8a7d7799e68537eefbc4bbb3.png
Hyria (Female, aged 25)
The first princess of the De Los Empire. Her full name is Hyria Vitalon Heinrich De Los.

Born to Emperor Leon and his favorite concubine Mary, she's the first princess and eldest of the Emperor's children. The spitting image of her father, she was his favorite child since she was young.

She doesn't seem as lively as her younger sister, Isabella, but she's more elegant and emotionally stronger. At the age of nineteen, she wed the son of a powerful noble family of her country through an arranged marriage, and has been single since her husband died.

After she came of age, she's traveled to many different places to familiarize herself with various cultures and get acquainted with powerful people around the world. She's interested in international relations and the balance of power. Her father understands this, so he often sends her to represent him in official diplomatic settings. A great socialite and a talented diplomat, she's acting as the face of the Empire.


Airship: The Philasia 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/c12ef7fa958d015e956dc8f1dc8c27517eb8c100.jpg
The former Archpriest Beldron's gift to Erje, and a royal treasure of the Ziben Empire.A long time ago, Empyrean received this airship from their ally, Celesti, as a token of friendship. It's been modified by the Seven Shards to best suit its new owner's needs, and it's named after Emperor Erje, whose surname is Philasia.

A. Entry
Complete the Empress Erje Act quest to enter this map.
You can enter it through the right-hand portal in Seria's Room.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/8b8b543498a152eef9e857e8f52ea8289b0f4b02.png

Use the Act quest reward, Ria's Communicator, to summon the Philasia in all towns.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/e3c98c0ee33fbe280c3801980a319af6b80d74fd.png

Ria's Communicator can't be used in Seria's Room, the Philasia, the Raid, Arena, or Special channels, or dungeons. If you didn't receive this Quest reward because you used Clear Quest, then you can always buy it from Captain Ria Richter's Shop.
 
B. Function 
1) Custom Machine
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/e49cea2bee0f8f7babf1f173e27a19425cbfe62f.png

 Enables you to set up Explorer Club Symbols and Philasia Flying Effects obtained through Explorer Club challenges.
 Enables you to preview the Explorer Club Symbols and Philasia Flying Effects available to obtain through Explorer Club challenges.

 
2) Control Panel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/9941014d7773c50daee38e66d618ab43a01e21e9.png

 Displays the basic information of the Level 100 dungeons, e.g., Exorcism, entry Fatigue, and Special reward count.
 Click a dungeon, and then Move, or double-click the dungeon slot to enter the dungeon lobby.

 
3) Safe and Mailbox
You can access your Safe, Account Vault, and Mailbox, just as you would in Seria's Room.

4) Move to Seria's Room
You can move to Seria's Room through NPC Captain Ria Richter.

The Elrox
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25789815/0a5c2358fc499d3ff6b21cdde40827b2f1a06345.jpg
The Ziben Empire's first airship created by the Seven Shards based on the Philasia's data. Named after the greatest general in Empyrean's history, it's loaded with the country's cutting-edge weapons that were further improved after the war with Apostle Anton.

Its impressive plasma cannon was designed by Melvin Richter and Farrel Wane, and then constructed by Gina Theodor. Its engine is based on Lindsey Rossum and Meryl Pioneer's design, and it's powered by a new type of fuel that Naen Siger has created by using various substances.

"Come on, guys. If you add just a little bit of magic here—"
- Hugh Fitzlary, before he got kicked off the ship by Meryl

A. Entry
Complete The Philasia's First Destination and Elrox in the Storm Episode quests to enter this map.
You can also move there through the upper portal in the Philasia or the Philasia's Control Panel.

notes.title: Regarding Account Hacking Attempts *UPDATE* APR 17
notes.content:
*UPDATE* APR 16

As mentioned in previous notice, if you were hacked between April 2nd and April 15th and you were using a secondary password, please send a ticket to our support team by April 28th. Although the root of the issue was not on our end, we are considering restoration of lost items for players who were using secondary password but still got compromised. Please note that tickets received after this date will not be considered for restoration. 

Also, keep in mind that while our investigation is on-going, the accounts will be unplayable until further notice. We can only ask for your utmost patience as it may take some time for the investigation to be finalized. Once done, the accounts will sure be returned without delay.

Furthermore, we are planning to enhance our game launcher’s security to possibly circumvent further incidents of account hacking, as well as another security campaign along the way.

As always, we recommend our valued players to use Google OTP on their accounts for security and never share your account information to anyone else.

Thank you.


========================================================

*UPDATE* APR 16

With the recent hacking attempts on our users, we have been thoroughly investigating and have found that the root of the issue was not on our end.
However, if you were using goblin pin, google otp/2nd password and were still hacked between APR 2 and APR 15, please send us a detailed ticket about the issue to our customer support team.

https://neople.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

And again, please be advised that using Google OTP is recommended to keep your account secure.
For information on how to register for a Google OTP, please scroll down or visit the link below.

https://member.dfoneople.com/security/googleAuthenticatorApply

Thank you.

========================================================


We have removed Goblin Pin re-issue feature from the security page to prevent any further damages to accounts that may be compromised.

========================================================

Dear DFO Adventurers,


It has come to our attention that there’s currently an on-going account hacking attempt on many of our users, and we are thoroughly investigating the situation. In the meantime, we highly recommend to use Google Authenticator to secure your account. To enable Google Authenticator, please follow the following steps:


1.    Log-in to your account at www.dfoneople.com
2.    Click on your account name on top right of the screen, select Security and go to Google Authenticator. You can also copy/paste https://member.dfoneople.com/security/googleAuthenticator to your browser.
3.    Once you are there, follow the steps on the screen to enable Google Authenticator on your account.


Once you are in-game, you may also add Goblin Pin to further secure your account.


Please wait for further announcement for news and updates regarding the matter.

Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: [Announcement] Official Statement Regarding Neo Premium Contract Removal
notes.content:
Dear Dungeon Fighter Online Adventurers,

 

We understand that many of you are upset about the recent removal of the Neo Premium Contract from the Neo Premium Vending Machine. We would like to offer our deepest apologies for the confusion this has caused by failing to inform the community in advance. With that said, please allow us to explain why we had to remove the Neo Premium Contract from the Neo Premium Vending Machine.

The Neo Premium Contract Trial (7-days), which can be purchased with gold, was added to the CERA Shop to allow new adventurers to try it and have an easier time during their first week of adventure. Additionally, Neo Premium Contract in the Neo Premium Vending Machine was a way for us to provide a small bonus to adventurers who enjoys playing our game.

However, it has recently come to our attention that gold farming bots and accounts are able to infinitely extend the period of this paid product and exploit it, to quickly and easily obtain gold. As a result, the amount of gold being produced has increased beyond our expectations and the in-game economy has been negatively impacted. 

In light of this, we had no choice but to remove Neo Premium Contract from the Cera Shop and the Neo Premium Vending Machine. We would truly appreciate your understanding on this matter, as we felt this had to be done in order to keep a sound in-game economy in the long run.

As part of our apology and as a token of our gratitude to the players, we will be sending out Neo Premium Contract Plus (7 Days) to adventurers who login after NOV 20th maintenance. We will also be increasing the amount of Terranium that replaced the Neo Premium Contract in the Neo Premium Vending Machine. 

Lastly, as many of you who have been with us since the beginning may know, we have a limited amount of resources and it is very difficult for us to create exclusive content. However, we are still working hard to bring content suited for the global community, and we hope you will think of this in good light.

 

Thank you for your love and support!

notes.title: [Announcement] Regarding Luke Solo Day Bug
notes.content:
Dear DFO adventurers,



We have found an issue with Luke Raid Solo Mode Challenge event where players are able to form a party and complete a normal Luke raid instead. This is not an intended feature of the event and it will be addressed as soon as possible.
Furthermore, there was a report that players are able to receive phase 1 rewards repeatedly by re-entering the raid after failling. According to our data, we have not found any players who have received multiple phase 1 rewards yet. Should we find any players who abused this kind of bug, they will be sanctioned.

As a compensation for this issue, players who cleared Luke Raid in Solo Mode on monday will receive the following items on September 18th maintenance.
- 1 Monolium
- 1 Epic Soul
(per character)

Please be advised that once the issue is fixed, if anyone is still found to be abusing the issue will be sanctioned as well.

We apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused.

Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: [Annoucnement] Update Regarding Server Outage
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,


At 21:52 (UTC) – 23:12 (UTC), the data center we are using experienced a power outage which resulted in loss of data and game server outage. Our sincerest apologies to everyone who were affected by this issue. However, please understand that this issue was solely caused by our data center and there was nothing we could do. We will be working with our data center to prevent similar issues in the future.

If you’ve experienced any other issues during this downtime, please submit a ticket to https://neople.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new.

Thank you.

notes.title: “HALLOWEEN: BURNING ACTION” UPDATE
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/23f612f172aa7be249502dafc70bc170693ce2a1.png

At Halloween, spooky but gorgeous beings come to Arad!
Starting today, Dungeon Fighter Online celebrates Halloween season with various contents and events! Halloween-themed Seria’s Room welcomes you and check out the newly released items!



 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/dbaf464219875960e2d5140be5b8fc5065faad2e.jpg
Play this Halloween special mini-game and collect Halloween Candies to get event exclusive rewards! Not only optimal level dungeons give you benefit, but also this Halloween special dungeon will please you!

Choose from our collection of Halloween special avatars filled with bizarre, sometimes scary and sometimes adorable characters! Not only that, a Succubus Avatar for Female Priest has been added as well! Do not miss the special offer available only for two weeks!



 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/e39e1bf6a94818e427425c387819a45deb51bff5.jpg

 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/6ad09796b165d113bc578596fce81532e8ef0f2d.png

https://youtu.be/2h2eDGelqAQ
 “REUNION”, the biggest change in the 2nd half of 2017 is happening!

 Features to change 
 Arad Explorer Club Update
Weapon Reinforcement & Armor Mastery UPDATE
Elementalist & Summoner Renewal
Character Balance Update
Arena Balance Update
and many more...

For more information, please visit our official website.

Thank you.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: [Announcement] About Game Disconnection on Jul 31, 2017
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

First, we would like to express our sincerest apologies for the lack of communication after the server-wide disconnection on JUL 31st. It took us more time than we expected to investigate the cause and come up with a resolution.

When the disconnection occurred, we were immediately notified and the issue was resolved with a client patch. However, due to some unknown side effects of the patch, there is now an issue with some items/skill description not showing properly. We are currently working on a fix for this and it will be resolved as soon as possible. 

Since all users were affected, there will be a server-wide compensation for all users on Aug 8 maintenance.

Again, we apologise for any inconveniences and we would like to ask for your understanding.

- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team

notes.title: [Announcement] Windows XP SP2 or lower no longer supported
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers,


We would like to inform you that Microsoft will be changing the authentication method of the Windows operating system starting from Jan 1, 2017. In line with this change, Dungeon Fighter Online will also be switching to the new authentication method, starting from DEC 27, 2016. A maintenance will be held on DEC 27 to implement the changes.

If you are using an operating system that is older than Windows XP Service Pack 2, please read the information below. For reference, Dungeon Fighter Online’s recommended operating system is Windows 7 or higher.

 
1. I am using Windows XP SP2. How will I be affected?

- You will not be able to execute the game after the new authentication method is in place.
 - Since the operating system is no longer supported, you will be exposed to various security threats.

 
2. Are Windows XP SP3 users affected?

- Windows XP SP3 users will not be affected by this change.
 - For security reasons, however, we recommend that you upgrade the operating system to a higher version.

 
3. How do I check the version of my Windows?

- Start -> Right click on My Computer -> Properties

 
4. I would like to know more about the authentication method change.

- The current authentication method is SHA-1 and it will be replaced with SHA-2. The Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA) is a cryptographic hash function used to provide secure communication between a web browser and a website.

 
Using an operating system that is no longer supported by the developer is not recommended as you will be exposed to various security threats. Please secure your PC by upgrading to an operating system that receives security updates.

 
Thank you.

 
- Dungeon Fighter Online Support Team -

notes.title: Introducing a new class: Demonic Lancer
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25789815/0c89f21202689153cd29e9b44a18e135847558e4.png

The lost children of Sirocco...
Now, they have raised their lances against the nobles of the empire.
Demonic Lancers abandoned their ambition and headed to Silver Crown to find a way to lift their accursed power and free themselves from the cycle of chaos...

Neople proudly introduces the long-anticipated new class: DEMONIC LANCER

Demonic Lancer can advance into two upper classes, 'Vanguard' & 'Skirmisher'.

Vanguard
Vanguards use heavy and powerful slashes to annihilate enemies in a wide range with halberds as a main weapon.

Skirmisher
 Stabbing/piercing is the Skirmisher's preferred style of attack. They are best at quickly engaging the enemy then quickly pulling back to safe distance with long lances as a main weapon.

Feel their fierce spearmanship from deep grudge and agony!

Visit our website for more update and event information!

Thanks to your support and interest, we could successfully launch DFO service on STEAM.
We are happy to see the current and new players enjoying the game and getting along with one another.


To express our gratitude, we have prepared a small gift to everyone.


Starting from 09:00 of Aug 16 to 09:00 of Aug 23, 2016 (UTC), you will be given a Daily Skeleton Pouch generating three Skeleton Keys daily upon logging in the game.

Please look forward to the Demonic Lancer on the next update as well ːsteamhappyː

Thank you for your love for DFO.
